key_insight: LLM4EHR aligns ICU clinical time-series with medical event sequences using a domain-adapted LLM plus a transformer encoder to learn more transferable patient representations.
clinical_relevance: By better linking event history and physiological trends, the model may improve downstream ICU prediction tasks and support adaptation to new patient cohorts.
method: Pre-train on ICU EHR data with joint event-sequence and time-series learning
Use a domain-adapted large language model to embed clinical events
Apply a regularised contrastive objective to align event embeddings with time-series representations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an ablation study showing improved downstream clinical task performance and k-shot transfer to new cohorts, with competitive overall results.
watch_item: The reported gains come from pre-training and adaptation experiments in ICU EHR data, so generalisability to other settings may require additional validation.
paper_title: LLM4EHR: Aligning Clinical Time Series with Medical Event Sequences via Large Language Models
